page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Numbered sections (IV., V., VI., VII.) are set as paragraph numbers. Catchword "VIII." at lower right.

main_text.p: Nos architectos nouitatis, & nouos tractatores ac verborum adinuentores, & quibus nō probrosissimis nominibus appellant. Quorum conuicia tantum abest vt indignè feramus, vt ni nos ipsorum calamitas dolore perpetuoque cruciatu afficeret, propemodum dicerem nos illorum maledictis gratiam habere, vt qui nobis conciliant beatitudinem. cap. 6.

Qui consueta fastidiunt, ac vetera [Prophetica & Apostolica dicta] tanquam obsoleta submouent, ii sunt qui nouas vocum fictiones recipiunt: quemadmodum qui in cultu studiosi sunt ornatus, semper nouam formam praeferunt communi. Item. Istorum verba ex noua sapientia inusta sunt ab ipsismet, qui in artificio pugnisq; verborum detriti sunt. cap. 7.

In nos machinas & insidias struunt, seque mutuo exhortantur ad ferendas suppetias, vt quisque peritia aut robore valet: ceterum id quod oppugnatur fides est, isque scopus communis est omnibus, vt soliditatè fidei in Christum labefactent, Apostolicam traditionem solo æquatam abolendo. cap. 10.
Illorum verba talia sunt, qualia solent esse hominum ira commotorum, qui ob rationem affectu obscuratam, à nullo temperant quod ad vlciscendum eum à quo offensi sunt, faciat. cap. 11.

page.notes: Catchword "VIII." is printed at lower right and is also the heading of the following section; it is recorded in bottom_margin only, and the matching paragraph number is kept in main_text as printed. The bracketed words "[Prophetica & Apostolica dicta]" are printed in italic inside square brackets, as shown. No margin notes. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout.
